title: The AI compute gap: Enterprises are buying infrastructure faster than they can measure what it costs
slides: Are your AI infrastructure costs already spiraling out of control?
Enterprises now buy compute faster than they track spending.
One in four firms has no real-time cost visibility at all.
Your next GPU purchase may double without warning.
Implement usage metering before your next procurement cycle.
thread_text:
1. Your GPU budget just exploded

One in four firms can't see costs in real time. They only find out after the invoice hits.

2. Speed of purchase vs. speed of tracking

Enterprises now buy compute faster than they track spending. Procurement is flying blind.

3. The hidden price jump

Your next GPU purchase may double without warning. No one is flagging the trend.

4. Metering is the missing link

Without usage metering, you can't tie cost to consumption. Only half the story is visible.

5. Act before your next cycle

Implement usage metering now. Test it on your current GPU stack—before procurement locks in the next order.
